A '''man-of-war'''<ref name="HESB">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a large military [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]. Men-o-war were used during the [[Pius Dea Era]] by both the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and its opponents. They were capable of exchanging fire across broadsides. They saw action during the [[Pius Dea Crusades]] when the [[Pius Dea]] sect used its control over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to launch military crusades against alien species in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] to subdue chaos in the name of [[The Goddess]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Men-o-war were still in use during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HESB" />
